systems.system: Système d'enregistrement des faits d'état civil (ESEC)
systems.owner: BUNEC, under MINDDEVEL's technical supervision; the communes named among its actors
systems.tiers: National; registration is described as manual with weak interconnection, and axis 3 of the plan (63% of FCFA 101.683 billion) is to computerise it and make it interoperable by 2029

note: A structured extract of the 2025-2029 plan to modernise civil registration: a plan for an application, costing its computerisation; the extract states nothing about how any commune office is connected.
